# Radzen usage (AP-RDZ)

[Back to catalog](index.md)

## AP-RDZ-01

**Invented Radzen API** — severity **blocker**, automated (tool), principles P-03, P-15.

**Why it hurts.** Members that do not exist in the installed Radzen.Blazor version compile-fail at best and silently misbehave at worst (for example an unknown attribute captured by an attribute splat).

**Fix.** Look the member up through the Radzen MCP, record MCP-### evidence, and let G5 prove it compiles. Never copy members from other component libraries.

**Bad:**

```razor
<RadzenDataGrid SmartPaging="true" RowsPerPageSelector="10,20" />   @* members that do not exist *@
```

**Verify with MCP:** `<Component> <member> parameter in Radzen.Blazor <version>`

**Detection:** G4 evidence check + G5 build.

## AP-RDZ-02

**Data grid bound to a fully materialized collection** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-10.

**Why it hurts.** A grid with Data= and no LoadData pages, sorts and filters in the browser/circuit after loading every row. Fine for small bounded lists; a performance and memory problem for unbounded data.

**Fix.** Use LoadData with server-side paging/sorting/filtering, Count and IsLoading. If the collection is provably bounded, waive with the bound as reason.

**Bad:**

```razor
<RadzenDataGrid Data="@allCustomers" AllowPaging="true">
```

**Good:**

```razor
<RadzenDataGrid Data="@page" Count="@total" LoadData="@LoadData" IsLoading="@loading" AllowPaging="true">
```

**Verify with MCP:** `RadzenDataGrid LoadData server-side paging sorting filtering with Count and IsLoading`

**Detection:** files `*.razor`; pattern `<RadzenDataGrid\b(?![^>]*\bLoadData\s*=)[^>]*\bData\s*=[^>]*>`.

## AP-RDZ-03

**LoadData without Count** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-10, P-08.

**Why it hurts.** Without Count the pager cannot know the total number of rows; paging breaks or shows one page only.

**Fix.** Set Count to the total number of matching rows returned by the server query.

**Bad:**

```razor
<RadzenDataGrid Data="@page" LoadData="@LoadData" AllowPaging="true">
```

**Good:**

```razor
<RadzenDataGrid Data="@page" Count="@total" LoadData="@LoadData" AllowPaging="true">
```

**Verify with MCP:** `RadzenDataGrid LoadData Count total rows paging`

**Detection:** files `*.razor`; pattern `<RadzenDataGrid\b(?=[^>]*\bLoadData\s*=)(?![^>]*\bCount\s*=)[^>]*>`.

## AP-RDZ-04

**Server query built from the raw filter string** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-07, P-10.

**Why it hurts.** LoadDataArgs.Filter is an expression string generated in the browser. Passing it into a server-side dynamic query or an OData/query-string parameter lets a client shape the query.

**Fix.** Translate the structured filters (LoadDataArgs.Filters / column filter values) into typed query parameters, or use the Radzen helpers against the grid columns on a trusted IQueryable. Validate allowed fields and operators on the server.

**Bad:**

```razor
var url = $"api/customers?$filter={args.Filter}";
```

**Good:**

```razor
var query = new CustomerQuery(args.Skip, args.Top, nameFilter);
```

**Verify with MCP:** `RadzenDataGrid LoadDataArgs Filters FilterDescriptor server-side query without Filter string`

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `(\.Where\s*\(\s*\w*[Aa]rgs\.Filter\s*\)|\{\s*\w*[Aa]rgs\.Filter\s*\}|\+\s*\w*[Aa]rgs\.Filter\b)`.

## AP-RDZ-05

**Dialog/notification services without component host** — severity **blocker**, automated (tool), principles P-16.

**Why it hurts.** DialogService and NotificationService only render when <RadzenComponents /> (or the individual hosts in older versions) is in the layout; otherwise calls silently do nothing.

**Fix.** Add <RadzenComponents /> to the main layout with the correct @rendermode (see profile).

**Bad:**

```razor
@inject DialogService Dialogs   (no <RadzenComponents /> anywhere)
```

**Good:**

```razor
MainLayout.razor: <RadzenComponents @rendermode="InteractiveServer" />
```

**Verify with MCP:** `Radzen Blazor RadzenComponents host DialogService NotificationService`

**Detection:** profile health RDZ-H02.

## AP-RDZ-06

**Radzen services not registered** — severity **blocker**, automated (tool), principles P-16.

**Why it hurts.** Components that inject DialogService, NotificationService, TooltipService or ContextMenuService throw at runtime when the services are not registered.

**Fix.** Call builder.Services.AddRadzenComponents() in every host that renders Radzen components (server and WebAssembly client).

**Bad:**

```razor
Program.cs without AddRadzenComponents()
```

**Good:**

```razor
builder.Services.AddRadzenComponents();
```

**Verify with MCP:** `Radzen Blazor AddRadzenComponents registration`

**Detection:** profile health RDZ-H01.

## AP-RDZ-07

**Dialog result used without null check** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-08.

**Why it hurts.** OpenAsync returns null when the user closes the dialog (Esc, X, Cancel). Casting or dereferencing the awaited result directly throws.

**Fix.** Pattern-match the result: if (await Dialogs.OpenAsync<Edit>(...) is Customer saved) { ... }.

**Bad:**

```razor
var c = (Customer)await DialogService.OpenAsync<EditCustomer>("Edit");
```

**Good:**

```razor
if (await DialogService.OpenAsync<EditCustomer>("Edit") is Customer c) { ... }
```

**Verify with MCP:** `Radzen DialogService OpenAsync result when dialog is closed`

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `(\(\s*[A-Z]\w*\s*\)\s*await\s+\w*[Dd]ialog\w*\.Open\w*Async\b|\(\s*await\s+\w*[Dd]ialog\w*\.Open\w*Async\b[^;]*\)\s*\.\w)`.

## AP-RDZ-08

**Grid reload inside a loop** — severity **minor**, automated (scanner), principles P-10.

**Why it hurts.** Each Reload triggers LoadData and a render; calling it per item multiplies server calls.

**Fix.** Perform the batch operation, then call Reload once.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `(foreach|for|while)\s*\([^)]*\)\s*\{[^{}]*\.Reload\s*\(`.

## AP-RDZ-09

**Theme registered twice** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-16.

**Why it hurts.** Combining <RadzenTheme> with a hard-coded theme stylesheet loads two themes; styles conflict and runtime theme switching breaks.

**Fix.** Use one mechanism, following the profile (radzen.theme).

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cshtml`, `*.html`; pattern `_content/Radzen\.Blazor/css/[\w-]+\.css`; only when the file contains `<RadzenTheme\b`.

## AP-RDZ-10

**Hand-built controls where Radzen is the standard** — severity **minor**, manual review (G7), principles P-05, P-02.

**Why it hurts.** Raw <table>/<input> markup next to Radzen components creates inconsistent look, keyboard behaviour and accessibility.

**Fix.** Use the repository wrapper or the Radzen component, unless there is a documented reason.

## AP-RDZ-11

**Floating Radzen.Blazor version** — severity **minor**, automated (scanner), principles P-04.

**Why it hurts.** Wildcard versions change the component API between builds; evidence recorded for one version may not hold for the next.

**Fix.** Pin the version (or pin it centrally in Directory.Packages.props).

**Detection:** files `*.csproj`, `Directory.Packages.props`; pattern `Include="Radzen\.Blazor"[^>]*Version="[^"]*\*`.

## AP-RDZ-12

**Overriding Radzen internal CSS classes** — severity **minor**, automated (scanner), principles P-02.

**Why it hurts.** Styling internal rz-* classes couples the app to Radzen internals that can change between versions.

**Fix.** Use theme variables (CSS custom properties) or component Style/CssClass parameters.

**Detection:** files `*.css`, `*.scss`, `*.razor.css`; pattern `(^|[\s,}])\.rz-[a-z0-9-]+[^{]*\{`.

## AP-RDZ-13

**Component host without interactive render mode** — severity **major**, automated (tool), principles P-16.

**Why it hurts.** With per-page render modes, a <RadzenComponents /> host without @rendermode renders statically, so dialogs, notifications and tooltips never appear.

**Fix.** Give the host the application render mode: <RadzenComponents @rendermode="InteractiveAuto" />.

**Detection:** profile health RND-H02.

## AP-RDZ-14

**LoadData grid without loading state** — severity **minor**, automated (scanner), principles P-08.

**Why it hurts.** Without IsLoading the grid shows stale or empty rows while the server call runs.

**Fix.** Bind IsLoading and set it around the server call.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`; pattern `<RadzenDataGrid\b(?=[^>]*\bLoadData\s*=)(?![^>]*\bIsLoading\s*=)[^>]*>`.
